said: The BIS Data Portal's real responses (its SDMX REST API, https://stats.bis.org/api/v2/), recorded by meridian-bis's authors on 2026-11-19, the body gzipped, as SDMX-CSV: every central bank policy rate (the WS_CBPOL dataflow, daily) from 3 August to 19 November 2026, and every long consumer price index level (the WS_LONG_CPI dataflow, monthly, 2010 = 100) from January 2025 to November 2026. The BIS allows use of its statistics provided the BIS is cited as the source, a translation is marked unofficial and no endorsement is implied; including them in a commercial product must not add a charge to its users (https://data.bis.org/help/legal). Sample data answers each request for a range from them, and the tests read them.
